cost_feasibility.description: Improvement 09: coarse cost-feasibility estimate, information only (O-3, 2026-10-01: costs are judged only by the backtest). plausibility=implausible never blocks approval.

assumed_round_trip_cost_bps.description: From config/cost_model.yaml round_trip_cost_bps for the primary symbol. E.g. BTCUSDT=17.0

expected_holding_bars.description: Estimated holding period range from hypothesis signal class and timeframe

expected_trades_per_window.description: Implied trade count per monthly window given holding period and any regime gating

plausibility.description: LLM judgment: can this signal class realistically earn required_gross_edge_bps_per_trade at this timeframe?

plausibility_rationale.description: Must reference the signal class and timeframe. E.g. '1h mean-reversion with ~6-bar holds must clear ~34 bps/trade gross; typical gross edges for this class are Y-Z bps'
